_metadata.description: OpenEmbedWorks tool catalog with faceted search metadata

categories.label: System & Runtime
categories.description: Kernel internals, ELF binaries, RTOS scheduling, and low-level runtime utilities

categories.label: Networking & Protocols
categories.description: Packet analysis, time sync, CAN/UDS, and messaging protocols

categories.label: Security
categories.description: Vulnerability analysis, exploitation research, and hardening tools

categories.label: Build & Binary Tools
categories.description: Compilers, build workflows, and binary tooling

categories.label: AI/ ML
categories.description: Model tooling, inference utilities, and ML-assisted workflows

tools.name: Hex Lens
tools.description: Browser-native hex editor to inspect, compare, edit, and save modified binaries.

tools.name: ELF Lens
tools.description: Parse and visualize ELF binary headers, sections, and symbol tables in the browser.

tools.name: Memory Map Viewer
tools.description: Visualize process memory maps and linker layout slices for runtime debugging.

tools.name: CAN Bus Analyzer
tools.description: Decode and inspect CAN bus frames with signal-level views and quick filtering.

tools.name: UDS Protocol Tool
tools.description: Build and decode UDS diagnostic messages for service-level troubleshooting.

tools.name: AUTOSAR Config Editor
tools.description: Edit AUTOSAR ARXML-like config data with structure-aware guidance.

tools.name: Chrono Lens
tools.description: Simulate RTOS scheduling to explore offsets, periods, priorities, preemption, and timing.

tools.name: gPTP Analyzer and Simulator
tools.description: Visualize and simulate IEEE 802.1AS time-sync behavior across nodes.

tools.name: PCAP Lens
tools.description: Inspect packet captures with filter scaffolding and quick protocol pivots.

tools.name: Compiler Explorer Lite
tools.description: Compile small C/C++ snippets and inspect assembly output and optimization effects.
